body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Western Digital (www.wdc.com) officially released 'WD TV Live Hub' to Korea after initially showing it at 'CES 2011' on January.
(Picture: connecting WD TV Live Hub to HDTV, screen is booting)
With 1TB installed, you can easily enjoy pictures, music and full HD images by HDTV. And it can be connected to SNS like Facebook, global video site like YouTube and internet service as Pandora.

Listening to music – when you wake up, how about choosing your favorite music and listening from big HDTV screen, rather than just clicking and playing music from small screen of laptop? It will give you more wonderful feeling for morning!

Enjoying picture – what if you're enjoying pictures together with your friends and family? No matter smart phone and tablet have excellent quality they're no match for HDTV, in terms of screen size. HDTV is a best choice for recollecting memories seating on a sofa. Because it provides album art according to each folder, the wonderful visual effect will be able to meet your standard.
Watching a movie – there'll be no product other than WD TV Live Hub, which supports hardware of Live Hub and intuitive UI, to enjoy music, pictures and movies altogether.

Social network and videos – as this function is dragging highest expectancy among those of WD TV Live Hub, we'll be experiencing more with enough time. Though it was just a short time, enjoying Facebook from big HD screen was easier and comfortable.
WD TV Live Hub – appropriate for enjoying contents via big HD screen. As it has various functions and usability, we're going to look through more and write more about it in the next article.
